channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump says US may target Iran’s Pickaxe Mountain ‘very soon’
item.description: US President Donald Trump has repeated an earlier warning that the US may attack Iran's Pickaxe Mountain "very soon".

item.title: ‘Small potatoes’: US President Trump downplays war on Iran
item.description: Trump tells reporters the US is 'not fighting right now' despite a recent exchange of fire with Iran.

item.title: Trump calls Iran war ‘small potatoes’, compares US deaths with Vietnam war
item.description: US President Donald Trump called the Iran war small potatoes, saying only 18 Americans had been killed.

item.title: Israeli strike kills two in southern Lebanon amid ongoing escalation
item.description: Israeli attacks against villages and towns in southern Lebanon continue despite truce agreements and diplomacy.

item.title: Mistrial declared in Lindsay Clancy murder case, after jury deadlocks
item.description: The mistrial now puts the murder case - and Clancy's future - in limbo as to whether she will be held criminally liable in the deaths of her three kids.

item.title: Steve Irwin's family celebrates 'superhero' dad, 20 years after shock death
item.description: The Australian icon was killed in 2006, after a stingray's barb pierced his chest during filming.

item.title: US diesel prices hit an all-time-high
item.description: Fuel prices have soared since the Iran conflict began at the end of February, mirroring the surge in wholesale oil prices.

item.title: How could US-Iran conflict end? Three experts give their views
item.description: After renewed strikes this week, does either side have an exit strategy?

item.title: 'We expect our sons to be killed,' father of teen shot dead in West Bank tells BBC
item.description: Palestinian teenagers Omar al-Naasan and Khalil Abu Alia were shot dead when Israeli settlers and soldiers entered a village in the occupied West Bank.
